<?php

function laplace(array $matrix): int
{
    $n = count($matrix);
    if ($n === 1) {
        return $matrix[0][0];
    }
    $total = 0;
    for ($j = 0; $j < $n; $j++) {
        $minor = [];
        for ($row = 1; $row < $n; $row++) {
            $values = $matrix[$row];
            array_splice($values, $j, 1);
            $minor[] = $values;
        }
        $term = $matrix[0][$j] * laplace($minor);
        $total += $j % 2 === 0 ? $term : -$term;
    }
    return $total;
}

$matrices = [
    [[2, -3, 1], [5, 4, -2], [-1, 6, 3]],
    [[3, 0, -2, 5], [1, 4, 7, -3], [-6, 2, 1, 8], [9, -5, 3, 2]],
    [[4, -1, 7, 0, -3], [2, 8, -5, 6, 1], [-9, 3, 2, -4, 5], [6, 0, -7, 3, -2], [1, -6, 4, 9, 8]],
];
foreach ($matrices as $matrix) {
    printf("det(%dx%d) = %d\n", count($matrix), count($matrix), laplace($matrix));
}
